title: Autonomous passenger-service operating outcomes
question: Which records connect autonomous passenger-service authority to actual trips, exposure-adjusted safety, availability, accessibility, cost, and local outcomes?
why_it_matters: Operating authority is a necessary gate, but service value and public legitimacy depend on measured operations and comparable outcomes.
current_support: FTFN now has CPUC authorization for Waymo fared driverless service in specified Los Angeles and San Francisco Peninsula areas, a current advice-letter ledger, California DMV testing-mile reports, NHTSA crash reporting, a reporting-enforcement action, and a bounded Zoox demonstration exemption.
missing_evidence: fleet size, service hours, availability, and cancellations
local emergency, curb, congestion, and enforcement records
candidate_records: carrier-level CPUC trip and service reports
DMV deployment activity and collision records
exposure-normalized NHTSA and local incident evidence
local accessibility, curb, emergency, congestion, and enforcement records
next_action: Follow effective CPUC authority into carrier-level service reports, DMV deployment records, exposure-adjusted safety analysis, local operating effects, accessibility, cost, and rider outcomes.

named_records: CPUC Driverless AV Deployment Advice Letter Status
California DMV 2024 Autonomous Vehicle Testing Mileage Release
NHTSA Standing General Order Crash Reporting
latest_review.stage_result: The road-autonomy trail now reaches effective fared passenger-service authority and measured testing exposure. It still lacks a complete public operating record for trips, fleet scale, availability, exposure-adjusted safety, accessibility, cost, and local effects.
latest_review.stop_rule: Do not treat authority, testing miles, raw crash reports, or a demonstration exemption as evidence of service scale, comparative safety, accessibility, or commercial performance.

notes: Phase 55Y separates road passenger-service outcomes from the existing eVTOL certification and service-readiness gap.
